# Patching and spawning

We found `g_secret` in memory. Now change it.

## 1. Read the key

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://attach/local//native_demo
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":46117,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}

[0x00000000]> Frxj 0x5c95c4681010 16
{"ok":true,"result":{"address":"0x5c95c4681010","size":16,"bytes":"4e34543156332d44334d302d4b335900"}}
```

## 2. Patch it

Write a new key with a NUL terminator. `PATCHED-KEY\0` is
`504154434845442d4b455900`:

```text
[0x00000000]> Frwj 0x5c95c4681010 504154434845442d4b455900
{"ok":true,"result":{"address":"0x5c95c4681010","size":12}}
```

Read it back:

```text
[0x00000000]> Frxj 0x5c95c4681010 16
{"ok":true,"result":{"address":"0x5c95c4681010","size":16,"bytes":"504154434845442d4b4559004b335900"}}
```

`PATCHED-KEY\0` followed by the tail of the old value. The comparison stops
at the NUL, so the new key is exactly `PATCHED-KEY`.

> **Note:** always include the terminator. Without it, `strcmp` runs into the
> old tail and the check fails.

## 3. Confirm the patch

Feed the new key in the demo's terminal:

```bash
Enter license key (q to quit): PATCHED-KEY
License ACCEPTED
```

![Patched and accepted](img/native_journey/patch-accepted.png)

And the original key is now rejected: the patch changed the gate itself.

## 4. Spawn

Attach requires a running process. Spawn starts one *suspended*:

```text
[0x00000000]> Frcj
{"ok":true,"result":{"pid":46117,"state":"closed"}}

[0x00000000]> Froj frida://spawn/local//./native_demo
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"spawn","pid":52038,"resumed":false,"rn":false,"state":"attached"}}
```

The target is frozen at its entry point. Nothing printed yet. Check:

```text
[0x00000000]> Frsj
{"ok":true,"result":{"active":true,"state":"attached","pid":52038,"action":"spawn","target":"./native_demo"}}
```

Resume it:

```text
[0x00000000]> Frrj
{"ok":true,"result":{"pid":52038,"resumed":true,"state":"attached"}}
```

The demo's banner appears as the process starts.

## 5. Launch

Launch is spawn plus automatic resume:

```text
[0x00000000]> Froj frida://launch/local//./native_demo
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"launch","pid":52849,"resumed":true,"state":"attached"}}
```

## 6. Closing semantics

- attach → target keeps running after `Frcj`
- launch → target keeps running
- spawn that was never resumed → target is **killed** on close

```text
[0x00000000]> Frcj
{"ok":true,"result":{"pid":52849,"state":"closed"}}
```

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    S[spawn] -->|suspended at entry| W[set hooks]
    W -->|Frrj| R[resumed]
    S -->|close before resume| K[killed]
    L[launch] -->|spawn + auto resume| R
    A[attach] -->|running process| R
```

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Patch the key to something of your own, prove it accepted, then spawn the
demo, list its modules while it is still suspended, resume, and close.
:::
